sentences.en: I intend to hammer this idea into the student's heads.
sentences.zh: 我打算把这个想法灌输给学生。

sentences.en: Party leaders are hammering out a proposal for political reform.
sentences.zh: 党领导人正在敲定一项政治改革提案。

sentences.en: I borrowed my father's hammer to build a dog house.
sentences.zh: 我借了爸爸的锤子来给狗造房子。
